# Duc - Disk Usage Checker

Duc is a collection of tools for indexing, inspecting and visualizing disk
usage. Duc maintains a database of accumulated sizes of directories of the file
system, and allows you to query this database with some tools, or create fancy
graphs showing you where your bytes are.

![duc gui](/img/palette-rainbow.png) 

## What is Duc?

Duc is a tool that helps you understand where your disk space is being used. It:

- Indexes your file system to track directory sizes
- Provides multiple interfaces to query and visualize disk usage
- Scales well (tested on systems with 500+ million files and petabytes of storage)
- Creates beautiful sunburst graphs to visualize space usage

## Usage

### Creating an Index

Before you can view disk usage information, you need to create an index:

```bash
duc index /usr
```

This will scan the specified directory and store size information in a database
(default location: `$HOME/.duc.db`).

### Querying the Index

Duc provides several commands to explore your disk usage:

- **`duc info`** - Show available directory trees in the database
- **`duc ls`** - List files and directories with their sizes
- **`duc ui`** - Interactive ncurses-based console interface
- **`duc gui`** - Graphical (X11) sunburst graph interface
- **`duc graph`** - Generate static graph images
- **`duc cgi`** - Web interface via CGI
- **`duc histogram`** - Show file size distribution
- **`duc topn`** - Show largest files
- **`duc xml`** - Export data as XML
- **`duc json`** - Export data as JSON

### Examples

Index your home directory:
```bash
duc index ~
```

List the top-level directories:
```bash
duc ls /
```

Launch the interactive UI:
```bash
duc ui /
```

Create a graph image:
```bash
duc graph /usr > /tmp/duc-graph.png
```

### Configuration

Duc can be configured via configuration files at:
- `/etc/ducrc`
- `~/.config/duc/ducrc`
- `~/.ducrc`
- `./.ducrc`

You can also set the database location using the `DUC_DATABASE` environment variable.

### Common Options

Most duc commands support these options:

- `-d`, `--database=FILE` - Specify database file location
- `-b`, `--bytes` - Show exact byte counts
- `-h`, `--help` - Show help information
- `-v`, `--verbose` - Increase output verbosity
- `-q`, `--quiet` - Quiet mode

### Indexing Options

When creating an index with `duc index`:

- `-e`, `--exclude=PATTERN` - Exclude files matching pattern
- `-x`, `--one-file-system` - Don't cross filesystem boundaries
- `-p`, `--progress` - Show progress during indexing
- `-H`, `--check-hard-links` - Count hard links only once
- `-m`, `--max-depth=N` - Limit directory depth stored in database
- `-u`, `--username=USER` - Index only files owned by specific user

### Visualization Options

For graphical commands (`duc gui`, `duc graph`):

- `--palette=SCHEME` - Color scheme (rainbow, greyscale, monochrome, size)
- `--fuzz=FACTOR` - Adjust visual size calculation
- `--levels=N` - Number of directory levels to show
- `--size=WxH` - Output image size

## More Information

For complete documentation including all commands and options, please refer to
the user manual (`duc.1` man page) in the `doc/` directory.

Check the Duc homepage at http://duc.zevv.nl for additional information.
</output>

duc(1) -- index, query and graph disk usage
===========================================

## SYNOPSIS

`duc` <subcommand> [options]


## DESCRIPTION

Duc is a collection of tools for inspecting and visualizing disk usage. 

Duc maintains an indexed database of accumulated sizes of directories of your
file system, and allows you to query this database with some tools, or create
fancy sunburst graphs to show you where your bytes are.

Duc scales quite well, it has been tested on systems with more than 500 million
files and several petabytes of storage. 


## USAGE

Duc comes with a command line tool called `duc`, which is used to create,
maintain and query the disk usage database.  run `duc help` to get a list of
available commands. `duc help <subcommand>` describes the usage of a specific
subcommand. Run `duc help --all` for an extensive list of all commands and
their options.

Some commands might not be available on your system, depending on the exact
configuration chosen when building Duc. (For example, the `duc gui` command is
not available in the `duc-nox` package on Debian and Ubuntu)

Duc allows any option to be placed either on the command line or in a
configuration file. Options on the command line are preceded by a
double-leading-dash (`--option`), some options have a corresponding short
option which can be used as well with a single leading dash. (`-o`)

At startup duc tries to read its configuration from three locations in this
particular order: `/etc/ducrc`, `~/.config/duc/ducrc`, `~/.ducrc` and
`./.ducrc`.

A configuration file consists of sections and parameters. The section names
correspond to the duc subcommands for which the parameters in that section
apply. A section begins with the name of the section in square brackets and
continues until the next section begins. Sections contain parameters, one per
line, which consist of a single option name for boolean flags, or an option name
and a value for options which take a value. See the EXAMPLES section for an
example of the configuration file format.


## CREATING THE INDEX

Duc needs an index file of the file system before it is able to show any
information.  To create the index, run the `duc index` command. For example, to
create an index of your home directory run `duc index ~`

    $ duc index /usr
    Skipping lost+found: Permission denied
    Indexed 333823 files and 48200 directories, (35.0GB total) in 1 seconds

The default location of the database is `$HOME/.duc.db`. To use a different
database location, use the DUC_DATABASE environment variable or specify the
database location with the --database argument.

You can run `duc index` at any time later to rebuild the index.

By default Duc indexes all directories it encounters during file system
traversal, including special file systems like /proc and /sys, and
network file systems like NFS or Samba mounts. There are a few options to
select what parts of your filesystem you want to include or exclude from the
scan, check the documentation below for the options --one-file-system, 
--exclude, --fs-exclude and --fs-include for more details.


## QUERYING THE INDEX

Duc has various subcommands for querying or exploring the index: (Note that
depending on your configuration, some of these commands might not be available)

* `duc info` shows a list of available directory trees in the database, and the time
  and date of the last scan.

* `duc ls` lists all files and directories under the given path on the console.

* `duc ui` runs a ncurses based console user interface for exploring the file
  system usage.

* `duc gui` starts a graphical (X11) interface representing the file system in
  a sunburst graph. Click on a directory to redraw the graph from the
  perspective of the selected directory. Click in the center of the graph to go
  up one directory in the tree.


## OPTIONS

This section list all available subcommands and describes their usage and options.

>>>> run duc help --all for a list of all subcommands and options.


## CGI INTERFACING

The `duc` binary has support for a rudimentary CGI interface, currently only
tested with apache.  The CGI interface generates a simple HTML page with a list
of indexed directories, and shows a clickable graph for navigating the file
system. If the option `--list` is given, a list of top sized files/dirs is also

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

* What does the error 'Database version mismatch mean?'
 
  The layout of the index database sometimes changes when new features are
  implemented. When you get this error you have probably upgraded to a newer
  version. Just remove the old database file and rebuild the index.

* Duc crashes with a segmentation fault, is it that buggy?

  By default Duc uses the Tokyocabinet database backend. Tokyocabinet is pretty
  fast, stores the database in a single file and has nice compression support
  to keep the database small. Unfortunately, it is not always robust and
  sometimes chokes on corrupt database files. Try to remove the database
  and rebuild the index. If the error persists contact the authors.

* Some of the Duc subcommands like `duc gui` are not available on my system?

  Depending on the configuration that was chosen when building Duc, some
  options might or might not be available in the `duc` utility. For example, on
  Debian or Ubuntu Duc comes in two flavours: there is a full featured package
  called `duc`, or a package without dependencies on X-windows called
  `duc-nox`, for which the latter lacks the `duc gui` command.

* `duc index` is hogging my system and using a lot of CPU and I/O!

  Traversing a file system is hard work - which is the exact reason why Duc
  exists in the first place. You can use the default tools to make Duc behave
  nice towards other processes on your machine, use something like:

  `nice 19 ionice -c 3 duc index [options]`

  This makes `duc index` run with the lowest CPU and I/O scheduler priorities,
  which is nicer to all the other processes on your machine.


## FILES

At startup duc tries to read its configuration from three locations in this
particular order: `/etc/ducrc`, `~/.config/duc/ducrc`, `~/.ducrc` and
`./.ducrc`.

Duc mainains an index of scanned directories, which defaults to ~/.duc.db. All tools
take the -d/--database option to override the database path.

## CGI INTERFACING

The `duc` binary has support for a rudimentary CGI interface, currently only
tested with apache.  The CGI interface generates a simple HTML page with a list
of indexed directories, and shows a clickable graph for navigating the file
system. If the option `--list` is given, a list of top sized files/dirs is also
written.

Configuration is done by creating a simple shell script as .cgi in a directory
which is configured for CGI execution by your web server (usually
`/usr/lib/cgi-bin`). The shell script should simply start duc, and pass the
location of the database to navigate.

An example duc.cgi script would be

    #!/bin/sh
    /usr/local/bin/duc cgi -d /home/jenny/.duc.db

* Make sure the database file is readable by the user (usually www-data)
* Debugging is best done by inspecting the web server's error log
* Make sure the .cgi script has execute permissions (`chmod +x duc.cgi`)

Some notes:

* The HTML page is generated with a simple embedded CSS style sheet. If the
  style is not to your liking you can provide an external CSS url with the
  --css-url option which will then be used instead of the embedded style
  definition.

def load_config():
    config = collections.defaultdict(dict)
    paths = [
        "/etc/ducrc",
        os.path.expanduser("~/.config/duc/ducrc"),
        os.path.expanduser("~/.ducrc"),
        os.path.abspath("./.ducrc"),
    ]
    for p in paths:
        if os.path.isfile(p):
            curr_sec = "global"
            try:
                with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
                    for line in f:
                        line = line.strip()
                        if not line or line.startswith("#") or line.startswith(";"):
                            continue
                        if line.startswith("[") and line.endswith("]"):
                            curr_sec = line[1:-1].strip().lower()
                        else:
                            parts = line.split(None, 1)
                            k = parts[0].strip().lower()
                            v = parts[1].strip() if len(parts) > 1 else True
                            config[curr_sec][k] = v
            except Exception:
                pass
    return config

def format_size(size, bytes_mode=False):
    if bytes_mode:
        return str(size)
    if size < 1024:
        return f"{int(size)}"
    
    units = ['K', 'M', 'G', 'T', 'P', 'E']
    val = float(size) / 1024.0
    u_idx = 0
    while val >= 1000.0 and u_idx < len(units) - 1:
        val /= 1024.0
        u_idx += 1
    
    return f"{val:.1f}{units[u_idx]}"

def format_count(count, bytes_mode=False):
    if bytes_mode:
        return str(count)
    if count < 1000:

def load_config():
    config = collections.defaultdict(dict)
    paths = [
        "/etc/ducrc",
        os.path.expanduser("~/.config/duc/ducrc"),
        os.path.expanduser("~/.ducrc"),
        os.path.abspath("./.ducrc"),
    ]
    for p in paths:
        if os.path.isfile(p):
            curr_sec = "global"
            try:
                with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
                    for line in f:
                        line = line.strip()
                        if not line or line.startswith("#") or line.startswith(";"):
                            continue
                        if line.startswith("[") and line.endswith("]"):
                            curr_sec = line[1:-1].strip().lower()
                        else:
                            parts = line.split(None, 1)
                            k = parts[0].strip().lower()
                            v = parts[1].strip() if len(parts) > 1 else True
                            config[curr_sec][k] = v
            except Exception:
                pass
    return config

def format_size(size, bytes_mode=False):
    if bytes_mode:
        return str(size)
    if size < 1024:
        return f"{int(size)}"
    
    units = ['K', 'M', 'G', 'T', 'P', 'E']
    val = float(size) / 1024.0
    u_idx = 0
    while val >= 1000.0 and u_idx < len(units) - 1:
        val /= 1024.0
        u_idx += 1
    
    return f"{val:.1f}{units[u_idx]}"

def format_count(count, bytes_mode=False):
    if bytes_mode:
        return str(count)
    if count < 1000:
        return str(count)
    units = ['K', 'M', 'G', 'T']
    val = float(count) / 1000.0
    u_idx = 0
    while val >= 1000.0 and u_idx < len(units) - 1:
        val /= 1000.0
        u_idx += 1
    return f"{val:.1f}{units[u_idx]}"

def get_db_path(subcmd, cli_db, config):
    if cli_db:
        return cli_db
    if "DUC_DATABASE" in os.environ and os.environ["DUC_DATABASE"]:
        return os.environ["DUC_DATABASE"]
    if "database" in config.get("global", {}):
        return config["global"]["database"]
    if "database" in config.get(subcmd, {}):
        return config[subcmd]["database"]
    
    home = os.path.expanduser("~")
    d1 = os.path.join(home, ".duc.db")
    if os.path.exists(d1):
        return d1
    d2 = os.path.join(home, ".cache", "duc", "duc.db")
    if os.path.exists(d2):
        return d2
    return d1

def load_config():
    config = collections.defaultdict(dict)
    paths = [
        "/etc/ducrc",
        os.path.expanduser("~/.config/duc/ducrc"),
        os.path.expanduser("~/.ducrc"),
        os.path.abspath("./.ducrc"),
    ]
    for p in paths:
        if os.path.isfile(p):
            curr_sec = "global"
            try:
                with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
                    for line in f:
                        line = line.strip()
                        if not line or line.startswith("#") or line.startswith(";"):
                            continue
                        if line.startswith("[") and line.endswith("]"):
                            curr_sec = line[1:-1].strip().lower()
                        else:
                            parts = line.split(None, 1)
                            k = parts[0].strip().lower()
                            v = parts[1].strip() if len(parts) > 1 else True
                            config[curr_sec][k] = v
            except Exception:
                pass
    return config

def format_size(size, bytes_mode=False):
    if bytes_mode:
        return str(size)
    if size < 1024:
        return f"{int(size)}"
    
    units = ['K', 'M', 'G', 'T', 'P', 'E']
    val = float(size) / 1024.0
    u_idx = 0
    while val >= 1000.0 and u_idx < len(units) - 1:
        val /= 1024.0
        u_idx += 1
    
    return f"{val:.1f}{units[u_idx]}"

def format_count(count, bytes_mode=False):
    if bytes_mode:
        return str(count)
    if count < 1000:
        return str(count)
    units = ['K', 'M', 'G', 'T']
    val = float(count) / 1000.0
    u_idx = 0
    while val >= 1000.0 and u_idx < len(units) - 1:
        val /= 1000.0
        u_idx += 1
    return f"{val:.1f}{units[u_idx]}"

def get_db_path(subcmd, cli_db, config):
    if cli_db:
        return cli_db
    if "DUC_DATABASE" in os.environ and os.environ["DUC_DATABASE"]:
        return os.environ["DUC_DATABASE"]
    if "database" in config.get("global", {}):
        return config["global"]["database"]
    if "database" in config.get(subcmd, {}):
        return config[subcmd]["database"]
    
    home = os.path.expanduser("~")
    d1 = os.path.join(home, ".duc.db")
    if os.path.exists(d1):
        return d1
    d2 = os.path.join(home, ".cache", "duc", "duc.db")
    if os.path.exists(d2):
        return d2
    return d1

def load_config():
    config = collections.defaultdict(dict)
    paths = [
        "/etc/ducrc",
        os.path.expanduser("~/.config/duc/ducrc"),
        os.path.expanduser("~/.ducrc"),
        os.path.abspath("./.ducrc"),
    ]
    for p in paths:
        if os.path.isfile(p):
            curr_sec = "global"
            try:
                with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
                    for line in f:
                        line = line.strip()
                        if not line or line.startswith("#") or line.startswith(";"):
                            continue
                        if line.startswith("[") and line.endswith("]"):
                            curr_sec = line[1:-1].strip().lower()
                        else:
                            parts = line.split(None, 1)
                            k = parts[0].strip().lower()
                            v = parts[1].strip() if len(parts) > 1 else True
                            config[curr_sec][k] = v
            except Exception:
                pass
    return config

def format_size(size, bytes_mode=False):
    if bytes_mode:
        return str(size)
    if size < 1024:
        return f"{int(size)}"
    
    units = ['K', 'M', 'G', 'T', 'P', 'E']
    val = float(size) / 1024.0
    u_idx = 0
    while val >= 1000.0 and u_idx < len(units) - 1:
        val /= 1024.0
        u_idx += 1
    
    return f"{val:.1f}{units[u_idx]}"

def format_count(count, bytes_mode=False):
    if bytes_mode:
        return str(count)
    if count < 1000:
        return str(count)
    units = ['K', 'M', 'G', 'T']
    val = float(count) / 1000.0
    u_idx = 0
    while val >= 1000.0 and u_idx < len(units) - 1:
        val /= 1000.0
        u_idx += 1
    return f"{val:.1f}{units[u_idx]}"

def get_db_path(subcmd, cli_db, config):
    if cli_db:
        return cli_db
    if "DUC_DATABASE" in os.environ and os.environ["DUC_DATABASE"]:
        return os.environ["DUC_DATABASE"]
    if "database" in config.get("global", {}):
        return config["global"]["database"]
    if "database" in config.get(subcmd, {}):
        return config[subcmd]["database"]
    
    home = os.path.expanduser("~")
    d1 = os.path.join(home, ".duc.db")
    if os.path.exists(d1):
        return d1
    d2 = os.path.join(home, ".cache", "duc", "duc.db")
    if os.path.exists(d2):
        return d2
    return d1

class DB:
    def __init__(self, db_path, is_index=False):
        self.db_path = db_path
        if not is_index:
            if not os.path.exists(db_path):
                sys.stderr.write(f"Error opening: {db_path} - Database not found\n")
                if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "info":
                    sys.stderr.write("Database not found\n")
                sys.exit(1)
        else:
            parent = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(db_path))
            if parent and not os.path.exists(parent):
                sys.stderr.write(f"Error opening: {db_path} - Database not found\n")
                sys.stderr.write("Database not found\n")
                sys.exit(1)
        try:
            self.conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
            self.conn.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS blobs(key UNIQUE PRIMARY KEY, value BLOB)")
            self.conn.commit()
        except Exception as e:
            sys.stderr.write(f"Error opening: {db_path} - {e}\n")
            sys.exit(1)

    def get(self, key):
        c = self.conn.cursor()
        c.execute("SELECT value FROM blobs WHERE key = ?", (key,))
        row = c.fetchone()
        if row:
            val = row[0]
            if isinstance(val, bytes):
                try:
                    val = val.decode('utf-8')
                except Exception:
                    pass
            try:
                return json.loads(val)
            except Exception:
                return val
        return None

    def set(self, key, value):
        if not isinstance(value, (str, bytes)):
            value = json.dumps(value)
        c = self.conn.cursor()
        c.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO blobs(key, value) VALUES(?, ?)", (key, value))
        self.conn.commit()

    def close(self):
        self.conn.close()

def parse_args_custom(cmd_args, flags, options, positional_default=None):
    parsed_flags = set()
    parsed_options = {}
    positionals = []
    
    i = 0
    while i < len(cmd_args):
        arg = cmd_args[i]
        matched = False
        
        # Check flags
        for name, short_aliases, long_aliases in flags:
            if arg in short_aliases or arg in long_aliases:
                parsed_flags.add(name)
                matched = True
                break
        if matched:
            i += 1
            continue
            
        # Check options
        for name, short_aliases, long_aliases in options:
            matched_opt = False
            for sa in short_aliases:
                if arg == sa:
                    if i + 1 < len(cmd_args):
                        parsed_options[name] = cmd_args[i+1]
                        i += 1
                    matched_opt = True
                    break
                elif arg.startswith(sa) and len(sa) > 2 and not sa.startswith('--'): # e.g. -dFILE
                    parsed_options[name] = arg[len(sa):]
                    matched_opt = True
                    break
            if matched_opt:
                matched = True
                break
            for la in long_aliases:
                if arg == la:
                    if i + 1 < len(cmd_args):
                        parsed_options[name] = cmd_args[i+1]
                        i += 1
                    matched_opt = True
                    break
                elif arg.startswith(la + '='):
                    parsed_options[name] = arg[len(la)+1:]
                    matched_opt = True
                    break
            if matched_opt:
                matched = True
                break
        if matched:
            i += 1
            continue
            
        positionals.append(arg)
        i += 1
        
    return parsed_flags, parsed_options, positionals

def load_config():
    config = collections.defaultdict(dict)
    paths = [
        "/etc/ducrc",
        os.path.expanduser("~/.config/duc/ducrc"),
        os.path.expanduser("~/.ducrc"),
        os.path.abspath("./.ducrc"),
    ]
    for p in paths:
        if os.path.isfile(p):
            curr_sec = "global"
            try:
                with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
                    for line in f:
                        line = line.strip()
                        if not line or line.startswith("#") or line.startswith(";"):
                            continue
                        if line.startswith("[") and line.endswith("]"):
                            curr_sec = line[1:-1].strip().lower()
                        else:
                            parts = line.split(None, 1)
                            k = parts[0].strip().lower()
                            v = parts[1].strip() if len(parts) > 1 else True
                            config[curr_sec][k] = v
            except Exception:
                pass
    return config

def format_size(size, bytes_mode=False):
    if bytes_mode:
        return str(size)
    if size < 1024:
        return f"{int(size)}"
    
    units = ['K', 'M', 'G', 'T', 'P', 'E']
    val = float(size) / 1024.0
    u_idx = 0
    while val >= 1000.0 and u_idx < len(units) - 1:
        val /= 1024.0
        u_idx += 1
    
    return f"{val:.1f}{units[u_idx]}"

def format_count(count, bytes_mode=False):
    if bytes_mode:
        return str(count)
    if count < 1000:
        return str(count)
    units = ['K', 'M', 'G', 'T']
    val = float(count) / 1000.0
    u_idx = 0
    while val >= 1000.0 and u_idx < len(units) - 1:
        val /= 1000.0
        u_idx += 1
    return f"{val:.1f}{units[u_idx]}"

def get_db_path(subcmd, cli_db, config):
    if cli_db:
        return cli_db
    if "DUC_DATABASE" in os.environ and os.environ["DUC_DATABASE"]:
        return os.environ["DUC_DATABASE"]
    if "database" in config.get("global", {}):
        return config["global"]["database"]
    if "database" in config.get(subcmd, {}):
        return config[subcmd]["database"]
    
    home = os.path.expanduser("~")
    d1 = os.path.join(home, ".duc.db")
    if os.path.exists(d1):
        return d1
    d2 = os.path.join(home, ".cache", "duc", "duc.db")
    if os.path.exists(d2):
        return d2
    return d1

class DB:
    def __init__(self, db_path, is_index=False):
        self.db_path = db_path
        if not is_index:
            if not os.path.exists(db_path):
                sys.stderr.write(f"Error opening: {db_path} - Database not found\n")
                if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "info":
                    sys.stderr.write("Database not found\n")
                sys.exit(1)
        else:
            parent = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(db_path))
            if parent and not os.path.exists(parent):
                sys.stderr.write(f"Error opening: {db_path} - Database not found\n")
                sys.stderr.write("Database not found\n")
                sys.exit(1)
        try:
            self.conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
            self.conn.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS blobs(key UNIQUE PRIMARY KEY, value BLOB)")
            self.conn.commit()
        except Exception as e:
            sys.stderr.write(f"Error opening: {db_path} - {e}\n")
            sys.exit(1)

    def get(self, key):
        c = self.conn.cursor()
        c.execute("SELECT value FROM blobs WHERE key = ?", (key,))
        row = c.fetchone()
        if row:
            val = row[0]
            if isinstance(val, bytes):
                try:
                    val = val.decode('utf-8')
                except Exception:
                    pass
            try:
                return json.loads(val)
            except Exception:
                return val
        return None

    def set(self, key, value):
        if not isinstance(value, (str, bytes)):
            value = json.dumps(value)
        c = self.conn.cursor()
        c.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO blobs(key, value) VALUES(?, ?)", (key, value))
        self.conn.commit()

    def close(self):
        self.conn.close()

def parse_args_custom(cmd_args, flags, options, positional_default=None):
    parsed_flags = set()
    parsed_options = {}
    positionals = []
    
    i = 0
    while i < len(cmd_args):
        arg = cmd_args[i]
        matched = False
        
        # Check flags
        for name, short_aliases, long_aliases in flags:
            if arg in short_aliases or arg in long_aliases:
                parsed_flags.add(name)
                matched = True
                break
        if matched:
            i += 1
            continue
            
        # Check options
        for name, short_aliases, long_aliases in options:
            matched_opt = False
            for sa in short_aliases:
                if arg == sa:
                    if i + 1 < len(cmd_args):
                        parsed_options[name] = cmd_args[i+1]
                        i += 1
                    matched_opt = True
                    break
                elif arg.startswith(sa) and len(sa) > 2 and not sa.startswith('--'): # e.g. -dFILE
                    parsed_options[name] = arg[len(sa):]
                    matched_opt = True
                    break
            if matched_opt:
                matched = True
                break
            for la in long_aliases:
                if arg == la:
                    if i + 1 < len(cmd_args):
                        parsed_options[name] = cmd_args[i+1]
                        i += 1
                    matched_opt = True
                    break
                elif arg.startswith(la + '='):
                    parsed_options[name] = arg[len(la)+1:]
                    matched_opt = True
                    break
            if matched_opt:
                matched = True
                break
        if matched:
            i += 1
            continue
            
        positionals.append(arg)
        i += 1
        
    return parsed_flags, parsed_options, positionals

                        else:

def format_size(size, bytes_mode=False):
    if bytes_mode:
        return str(size)
    if size < 1024:
        return f"{int(size)}"
    
    units = ['K', 'M', 'G', 'T', 'P', 'E']
    val = float(size) / 1024.0
    u_idx = 0
    while val >= 1000.0 and u_idx < len(units) - 1:
        val /= 1024.0
        u_idx += 1
    
    return f"{val:.1f}{units[u_idx]}"

def format_count(count, bytes_mode=False):

    units = ['K', 'M', 'G', 'T']

    u_idx = 0
    while val >= 1000.0 and u_idx < len(units) - 1:

    if size < 1024:
        return f"{int(size)}"
    
    units = ['K', 'M', 'G', 'T', 'P', 'E']
    val = float(size) / 1024.0
    u_idx = 0
    while val >= 1000.0 and u_idx < len(units) - 1:
        val /= 1024.0
        u_idx += 1
    
    return f"{val:.1f}{units[u_idx]}"

def format_count(count, bytes_mode=False):
    if bytes_mode:
        return str(count)
    if count < 1000:
        return str(count)
    units = ['K', 'M', 'G', 'T']
    val = float(count) / 1000.0
    u_idx = 0
    while val >= 1000.0 and u_idx < len(units) - 1:
        val /= 1000.0
        u_idx += 1
    return f"{val:.1f}{units[u_idx]}"

def get_db_path(subcmd, cli_db, config):
    if cli_db:
        return cli_db
    if "DUC_DATABASE" in os.environ and os.environ["DUC_DATABASE"]:
        return os.environ["DUC_DATABASE"]
    if "database" in config.get("global", {}):
        return config["global"]["database"]
    if "database" in config.get(subcmd, {}):
        return config[subcmd]["database"]
    
    home = os.path.expanduser("~")
    d1 = os.path.join(home, ".duc.db")
    if os.path.exists(d1):
        return d1
    d2 = os.path.join(home, ".cache", "duc", "duc.db")
    if os.path.exists(d2):
        return d2
    return d1

class DB:
    def __init__(self, db_path, is_index=False):
        self.db_path = db_path
        if not is_index:
            if not os.path.exists(db_path):
                sys.stderr.write(f"Error opening: {db_path} - Database not found\n")
                if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "info":
                    sys.stderr.write("Database not found\n")
                sys.exit(1)
        else:
            parent = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(db_path))
            if parent and not os.path.exists(parent):
                sys.stderr.write(f"Error opening: {db_path} - Database not found\n")
                sys.stderr.write("Database not found\n")
                sys.exit(1)
        try:
            self.conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
            self.conn.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS blobs(key UNIQUE PRIMARY KEY, value BLOB)")
            self.conn.commit()
        except Exception as e:
            sys.stderr.write(f"Error opening: {db_path} - {e}\n")
            sys.exit(1)

    def get(self, key):
        c = self.conn.cursor()
        c.execute("SELECT value FROM blobs WHERE key = ?", (key,))
        row = c.fetchone()
        if row:
            val = row[0]
            if isinstance(val, bytes):
                try:
                    val = val.decode('utf-8')
                except Exception:
                    pass
            try:
                return json.loads(val)
            except Exception:
                return val
        return None

    def set(self, key, value):
        if not isinstance(value, (str, bytes)):
            value = json.dumps(value)
        c = self.conn.cursor()
        c.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO blobs(key, value) VALUES(?, ?)", (key, value))
        self.conn.commit()

    def close(self):
        self.conn.close()

def parse_args_custom(cmd_args, flags, options):
    parsed_flags = set()
    parsed_options = {}
    positionals = []
    
    i = 0
    while i < len(cmd_args):
        arg = cmd_args[i]
        matched = False
        
        for name, short_aliases, long_aliases in flags:
            if arg in short_aliases or arg in long_aliases:
                parsed_flags.add(name)
                matched = True
                break
        if matched:
            i += 1
            continue
            
        for name, short_aliases, long_aliases in options:
            matched_opt = False
            for sa in short_aliases:
                if arg == sa:
                    if i + 1 < len(cmd_args):
                        parsed_options[name] = cmd_args[i+1]
                        i += 1
                    matched_opt = True
                    break
                elif arg.startswith(sa) and len(sa) > 2 and not sa.startswith('--'):
                    parsed_options[name] = arg[len(sa):]
                    matched_opt = True
                    break
            if matched_opt:
                matched = True
                break
            for la in long_aliases:
                if arg == la:
                    if i + 1 < len(cmd_args):
                        parsed_options[name] = cmd_args[i+1]
                        i += 1
                    matched_opt = True
                    break
                elif arg.startswith(la + '='):
                    parsed_options[name] = arg[len(la)+1:]
                    matched_opt = True
                    break
            if matched_opt:
                matched = True
                break
        if matched:
            i += 1
            continue
            
        positionals.append(arg)
        i += 1
        
    return parsed_flags, parsed_options, positionals

def cmd_index(cmd_args, config):
    flags_def = [
        ("bytes", ["-b"], ["--bytes"]),
        ("progress", ["-p"], ["--progress"]),
        ("one_file_system", ["-x"], ["--one-file-system"]),
        ("check_hard_links", ["-H"], ["--check-hard-links"]),
        ("hide_file_names", [], ["--hide-file-names"]),
        ("verbose", ["-v"], ["--verbose"]),
        ("debug", [], ["--debug"]),
        ("dry_run", [], ["--dry-run"]),
    ]
    opts_def = [
        ("database", ["-d"], ["--database"]),
        ("exclude", ["-e"], ["--exclude"]),
        ("max_depth", ["-m"], ["--max-depth"]),
        ("uid", ["-U"], ["--uid"]),
        ("username", ["-u"], ["--username"]),
        ("topn", ["-T"], ["--topn"]),
        ("topn_min", ["-M"], ["--topn-min"]),
    ]
    flags, opts, positionals = parse_args_custom(cmd_args, flags_def, opts_def)
    
    if not positionals:
        sys.stderr.write("duc: missing path argument\n")
        sys.exit(1)
        
    db_path = get_db_path("index", opts.get("database"), config)
    dry_run = "dry_run" in flags
    verbose = "verbose" in flags or "debug" in flags
    
    db = DB(db_path, is_index=True) if not dry_run else None
    
    if verbose and not dry_run:
        sys.stderr.write(f'Writing to database "{db_path}"\n')
        
    for p in positionals:
        canon_path = os.path.realpath(p)
        start_time = time.time()
        
        hist = [0] * 48
        seen_inodes = set() if "check_hard_links" in flags else None
        
        def scan_dir(curr_path, depth):
            try:
                st = os.lstat(curr_path)
            except Exception:
                return None, 0, 0, 0, 0
                
            dir_st_dev = st.st_dev
            children = []
            tot_act = 0
            tot_app = 0
            tot_files = 0
            tot_dirs = 0
            
            try:
                entries = list(os.scandir(curr_path))
            except Exception:
                entries = []
                
            for entry in entries:
                name = entry.name
                if "exclude" in opts and fnmatch.fnmatch(name, opts["exclude"]):
                    continue
                    
                try:
                    e_st = entry.stat(follow_symlinks=False)
                except Exception:
                    continue
                    
                if "one_file_system" in flags and e_st.st_dev != dir_st_dev:
                    continue
                    
                if seen_inodes is not None and e_st.st_nlink > 1:
                    key = (e_st.st_dev, e_st.st_ino)
                    if key in seen_inodes:
                        continue
                    seen_inodes.add(key)
                    
                is_d = entry.is_dir(follow_symlinks=False)
                act_s = getattr(e_st, 'st_blocks', 0) * 512 if hasattr(e_st, 'st_blocks') else e_st.st_size
                app_s = e_st.st_size
                
                bkt = 0
                if act_s > 0:
                    bkt = min(47, max(0, int(math.log2(act_s))))
                hist[bkt] += 1
                
                if is_d:
                    tot_dirs += 1
                    child_node, sub_act, sub_app, sub_f, sub_d = scan_dir(entry.path, depth + 1)
                    c_act = sub_act
                    c_app = sub_app
                    c_cnt = sub_f + sub_d + 1
                    tot_act += c_act
                    tot_app += c_app
                    tot_files += sub_f
                    tot_dirs += sub_d
                    children.append({
                        "name": name,
                        "is_dir": True,
                        "size_actual": c_act,
                        "size_apparent": c_app,
                        "count": c_cnt
                    })
                else:
                    tot_files += 1
                    tot_act += act_s
                    tot_app += app_s
                    c_name = name if "hide_file_names" not in flags else f"file_{tot_files}"
                    children.append({
                        "name": c_name,
                        "is_dir": False,
                        "size_actual": act_s,
                        "size_apparent": app_s
                    })
                    
            node = {
                "path": curr_path,
                "size_actual": tot_act,
                "size_apparent": tot_app,
                "count": tot_files + tot_dirs + 1,
                "dir_count": tot_dirs + 1,
                "children": children
            }
            if db:
                db.set(curr_path, node)
            return node, tot_act, tot_app, tot_files, tot_dirs
            
        root_node, tot_act, tot_app, tot_files, tot_dirs = scan_dir(canon_path, 0)
        dur = max(0.0, time.time() - start_time)
        
        if db:
            reports = db.get("duc_index_reports") or []
            if not isinstance(reports, list):
                reports = []
            now = datetime.datetime.now()
            rep = {
                "path": canon_path,
                "date": now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
                "time": now.strftime("%H:%M:%S"),
                "files": tot_files,
                "dirs": tot_dirs + 1,
                "size_actual": tot_act,
                "size_apparent": tot_app,
                "histogram": hist
            }
            updated = False
            for idx, r in enumerate(reports):
                if r.get("path") == canon_path:
                    reports[idx] = rep
                    updated = True
                    break
            if not updated:
                reports.append(rep)
            db.set("duc_index_reports", reports)
            
        if verbose:
            app_f = f"{tot_app}B" if tot_app < 1024 else f"{format_size(tot_app)}B"
            act_f = f"{tot_act}B" if tot_act < 1024 else f"{format_size(tot_act)}B"
            sys.stderr.write(f"Indexed {tot_files} files and {tot_dirs + 1} directories, ({app_f} apparent, {act_f} actual) in {dur:.2f} secs.\n")
            
    if db:
        db.close()

def cmd_ls(cmd_args, config):
    flags_def = [
        ("apparent", ["-a"], ["--apparent"]),
        ("bytes", ["-b"], ["--bytes"]),
        ("classify", ["-F"], ["--classify"]),
        ("count", [], ["--count"]),
        ("directory", ["-D"], ["--directory"]),
        ("dirs_only", [], ["--dirs-only"]),
        ("full_path", [], ["--full-path"]),
        ("graph", ["-g"], ["--graph"]),
        ("name_sort", ["-n"], ["--name-sort"]),
        ("recursive", ["-R"], ["--recursive"]),
        ("ascii", [], ["--ascii"]),
    ]
    opts_def = [
        ("database", ["-d"], ["--database"]),
        ("levels", ["-l"], ["--levels"]),
    ]
    flags, opts, positionals = parse_args_custom(cmd_args, flags_def, opts_def)
    
    # Check config section ls
    ls_cfg = config.get("ls", {})
    if "classify" in ls_cfg and ls_cfg["classify"]: flags.add("classify")
    if "color" in ls_cfg and ls_cfg["color"]: flags.add("color")
    if "recursive" in ls_cfg and ls_cfg["recursive"]: flags.add("recursive")
    
    db_path = get_db_path("ls", opts.get("database"), config)
    db = DB(db_path)
    
    user_path = positionals[0] if positionals else "."
    canon_path = os.path.realpath(user_path)
    
    node = db.get(canon_path)
    if not node:
        node = db.get(user_path)
    if not node:
        sys.stderr.write(f"Path {canon_path} not found in database\n")
        sys.stderr.write(f"The requested path '{user_path}' was not found in the database,\n")
        sys.stderr.write("Please run 'duc info' for a list of available directories.\n")
        db.close()
        sys.exit(1)
        
    bytes_mode = "bytes" in flags
    apparent_mode = "apparent" in flags
    count_mode = "count" in flags
    classify = "classify" in flags
    graph_mode = "graph" in flags
    name_sort = "name_sort" in flags
    dirs_only = "dirs_only" in flags
    
    def get_val(c):
        if count_mode:
            return c.get("count", 1) if c.get("is_dir") else 1
        return c.get("size_apparent" if apparent_mode else "size_actual", 0)
        
    if "directory" in flags:
        v = get_val(node)
        s_str = format_count(v, bytes_mode) if count_mode else format_size(v, bytes_mode)
        w = 12 if bytes_mode else 6
        print(f"{s_str:>{w}s} {canon_path}")
        db.close()
        return
        
    children = node.get("children", [])
    if dirs_only:
        children = [c for c in children if c.get("is_dir")]
        
    if name_sort:
        children.sort(key=lambda c: c.get("name", "").lower())
    else:
        children.sort(key=lambda c: (-get_val(c), c.get("name", "").lower()))
        
    max_val = max([get_val(c) for c in children], default=1)
    
    if "recursive" in flags:
        max_levels = int(opts.get("levels", 4))
        
        def render_tree(curr_path, prefix, level):
            curr_node = db.get(curr_path)
            if not curr_node:
                return
            ch = curr_node.get("children", [])
            if dirs_only:
                ch = [c for c in ch if c.get("is_dir")]
            if name_sort:
                ch.sort(key=lambda c: c.get("name", "").lower())
            else:
                ch.sort(key=lambda c: (-get_val(c), c.get("name", "").lower()))
                
            for idx, c in enumerate(ch):
                is_last = (idx == len(ch) - 1)
                v = get_val(c)
                s_str = format_count(v, bytes_mode) if count_mode else format_size(v, bytes_mode)
                w = 12 if bytes_mode else 6
                
                c_is_dir = c.get("is_dir", False)
                c_name = c.get("name", "")
                
                if "full_path" in flags:
                    rel_p = os.path.relpath(os.path.join(curr_path, c_name), canon_path)
                    print(f"{s_str:>{w}s} {rel_p}")
                else:
                    if "ascii" in flags:
                        if c_is_dir:
                            branch = " `+- " if is_last else " |+- "
                        else:
                            branch = " `- " if is_last else " |- "
                    else:
                        if c_is_dir:
                            branch = " ╰┬─ " if is_last else " ├┬─ "
                        else:
                            branch = " ╰─ " if is_last else " ├─ "
                            
                    disp_name = c_name + "/" if classify and c_is_dir else (c_name + " " if classify else c_name)
                    print(f"{s_str:>{w}s}{prefix}{branch}{disp_name}")
                    
                if c_is_dir and level < max_levels:
                    sub_p = os.path.join(curr_path, c_name)
                    if "ascii" in flags:
                        next_prefix = prefix + ("     " if is_last else " |   ")
                    else:
                        next_prefix = prefix + ("     " if is_last else " │   ")
                    render_tree(sub_p, next_prefix, level + 1)
                    
        render_tree(canon_path, "", 1)
    else:
        max_nlen = max([len(c.get("name", "") + ("/" if classify and c.get("is_dir") else (" " if classify else ""))) for c in children], default=10)
        max_nlen = max(10, max_nlen)
        for c in children:
            v = get_val(c)
            s_str = format_count(v, bytes_mode) if count_mode else format_size(v, bytes_mode)
            w = 12 if bytes_mode else 6
            c_name = c.get("name", "")
            if classify:
                c_name = c_name + "/" if c.get("is_dir") else c_name + " "
            if graph_mode:
                p_cnt = round(46 * v / max_val) if max_val > 0 else 0
                g_str = f" [{'+'*p_cnt:<46s}]"
                print(f"{s_str:>{w}s} {c_name:<{max_nlen}s}{g_str}")
            else:
                print(f"{s_str:>{w}s} {c_name}")
            
    db.close()

def cmd_xml(cmd_args, config):
    flags_def = [
        ("apparent", ["-a"], ["--apparent"]),
        ("exclude_files", ["-x"], ["--exclude-files"]),
    ]
    opts_def = [
        ("database", ["-d"], ["--database"]),

    ]

    db_path = get_db_path("xml", opts.get("database"), config)
    db = DB(db_path)
    
    user_p = positionals[0] if positionals else "."
    canon_p = os.path.realpath(user_p)
    node = db.get(canon_p) or db.get(user_p)
    if not node:
        sys.stderr.write(f"Path {canon_p} not found in database\n")
        db.close()
        sys.exit(1)
        
    min_s = int(opts.get("min_size", 0))
    app_mode = "apparent" in flags
    ex_files = "exclude_files" in flags
    
    print('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>')
    
    def dump_node(p_path, n, indent):
        s_app = n.get("size_apparent", 0)
        s_act = n.get("size_actual", 0)
        s_check = s_app if app_mode else s_act
        if s_check < min_s:
            return
            
        cnt = n.get("count", 1)
        ind_str = " " * indent
        
        if indent == 0:
            print(f'<duc root="{n.get("path", p_path)}" size_apparent="{s_app}" size_actual="{s_act}" count="{cnt}">')
        else:
            name = os.path.basename(p_path)
            print(f'{ind_str}<ent type="dir" name="{name}" size_apparent="{s_app}" size_actual="{s_act}" count="{cnt}">')
            
        ch = n.get("children", [])
        for c in ch:
            c_name = c.get("name", "")
            c_is_d = c.get("is_dir", False)
            c_app = c.get("size_apparent", 0)
            c_act = c.get("size_actual", 0)
            c_chk = c_app if app_mode else c_act
            
            if c_chk < min_s:
                continue
                
            if c_is_d:
                sub_p = os.path.join(p_path, c_name)
                sub_n = db.get(sub_p)
                if sub_n:
                    dump_node(sub_p, sub_n, indent + 1)
                else:
                    sub_cnt = c.get("count", 1)
                    print(f'{" "*(indent+1)}<ent type="dir" name="{c_name}" size_apparent="{c_app}" size_actual="{c_act}" count="{sub_cnt}">\n{" "*(indent+1)}</ent>')
            elif not ex_files:
                print(f'{" "*(indent+1)}<ent name="{c_name}" size_apparent="{c_app}" size_actual="{c_act}" />')
                
        if indent == 0:
            print('</duc>')
        else:
            print(f'{ind_str}</ent>')
            
    dump_node(canon_p, node, 0)
    db.close()

        s_act = n.get("size_actual", 0)
        s_chk = s_app if app_mode else s_act
        if s_chk < min_s:
            return None
            
        obj = {
            "name": n.get("path", p_path) if is_root else os.path.basename(p_path),
            "count": n.get("count", 1),
            "size_apparent": s_app,
            "size_actual": s_act,
            "children": []
        }
        
        ch = n.get("children", [])
        for c in ch:
            c_name = c.get("name", "")
            c_is_d = c.get("is_dir", False)
            c_app = c.get("size_apparent", 0)
            c_act = c.get("size_actual", 0)
            c_chk = c_app if app_mode else c_act
            
            if c_chk < min_s:
                continue
                
            if c_is_d:
                sub_p = os.path.join(p_path, c_name)
                sub_n = db.get(sub_p)
                if sub_n:
                    sub_obj = build_tree(sub_p, sub_n, False)
                    if sub_obj:
                        obj["children"].append(sub_obj)
                else:
                    obj["children"].append({
                        "name": c_name,
                        "count": c.get("count", 1),
                        "size_apparent": c_app,
                        "size_actual": c_act,
                        "children": []
                    })
            elif not ex_files:
                obj["children"].append({
                    "name": c_name,
                    "size_apparent": c_app,
                    "size_actual": c_act
                })
        return obj
        
    res_obj = build_tree(canon_p, node, True)
    if res_obj:
        print(json.dumps(res_obj, indent=2))
    db.close()

def cmd_graph(cmd_args, config):
    flags_def = [
        ("apparent", ["-a"], ["--apparent"]),
        ("count", [], ["--count"]),
        ("gradient", [], ["--gradient"]),
    ]
    opts_def = [
        ("database", ["-d"], ["--database"]),
        ("format", ["-f"], ["--format"]),
        ("output", ["-o"], ["--output"]),
        ("size", ["-s"], ["--size"]),
        ("levels", ["-l"], ["--levels"]),
        ("palette", [], ["--palette"]),
        ("fuzz", [], ["--fuzz"]),
        ("ring_gap", [], ["--ring-gap"]),
        ("dpi", [], ["--dpi"]),
    ]
    flags, opts, positionals = parse_args_custom(cmd_args, flags_def, opts_def)
    
    db_path = get_db_path("graph", opts.get("database"), config)
    db = DB(db_path)
    
    user_p = positionals[0] if positionals else "."
    canon_p = os.path.realpath(user_p)
    node = db.get(canon_p) or db.get(user_p)
    if not node:
        sys.stderr.write(f"Path {canon_p} not found in database\n")
        db.close()
        sys.exit(1)
        
    fmt = opts.get("format", "png").lower()
    out_file = opts.get("output", "duc.png")
    img_size = int(opts.get("size", 800))
    max_levels = int(opts.get("levels", 4))
    app_mode = "apparent" in flags
    count_mode = "count" in flags
    
    def get_val(item):
        if count_mode:
            return item.get("count", 1)
        return item.get("size_apparent" if app_mode else "size_actual", 0)
        
    wedges = []
    colors = ['#ffd299', '#ebff99', '#abff99', '#99fff0', '#99f8ff', '#99e3ff', '#99d5ff', '#99ceff', '#99c6ff', '#99bfff', '#99b8ff', '#99b1ff', '#99aaff', '#99a3ff', '#999cff', '#9c99ff', '#a399ff', '#aa99ff', '#b199ff', '#b899ff', '#c099ff']
    
    def process_node(curr_p, curr_n, level, start_angle, end_angle):
        if level > max_levels:
            return
        tot = get_val(curr_n)
        if tot <= 0:
            return
            
        ch = curr_n.get("children", [])
        if count_mode:
            ch.sort(key=lambda c: c.get("count", 1), reverse=True)
        else:
            ch.sort(key=lambda c: c.get("size_apparent" if app_mode else "size_actual", 0), reverse=True)
            
        a = start_angle
        angle_span = end_angle - start_angle
        
        for idx, c in enumerate(ch):
            v = get_val(c)
            if v <= 0:
                continue
            frac = v / tot
            next_a = a + frac * angle_span
            color = colors[(level * 5 + idx) % len(colors)]
            wedges.append((level, a, next_a, c.get("name", ""), v, color))
            
            if c.get("is_dir"):
                sub_p = os.path.join(curr_p, c.get("name", ""))
                sub_n = db.get(sub_p)
                if sub_n:
                    process_node(sub_p, sub_n, level + 1, a, next_a)
            a = next_a
            
    tot_val = get_val(node)
    wedges.append((0, 0, 2 * math.pi, node.get("path", canon_p), tot_val, '#ff6666'))
    process_node(canon_p, node, 1, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    
    if fmt == 'svg':
        cx = img_size / 2.0
        cy = img_size / 2.0
        r_inner = img_size * 0.1
        r_step = (img_size * 0.4) / max_levels
        
        svg_lines = [
            "<?xml version='1.0' standalone='no'?>",
            "<!DOCTYPE svg PUBLIC '-//W3C//DTD SVG 1.1//EN' ",
            " 'http://www.w3.org/Graphics/SVG/1.1/DTD/svg11.dtd'>",
            f"<svg width='{img_size}px' height='{img_size}px'",
            "     xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'",
            "     xmlns:xlink='http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink'>",
            " <style><![CDATA[",
            "    text {",
            "      font-family: 'Arial';",
            "      text-anchor: middle;",
            "      dominant-baseline: middle;",
            "    }",
            "    radialGradient {",
            "      gradientUnits: userSpaceOnUse;",
            "    }",
            "  ]]>",
            "</style>"
        ]
        
        for w in wedges:
            lvl, a1, a2, name, val, col = w
            if lvl == 0:
                continue
            r1 = r_inner + (lvl - 1) * r_step
            r2 = r1 + r_step
            
            x1 = cx + r1 * math.cos(a1 - math.pi/2)
            y1 = cy + r1 * math.sin(a1 - math.pi/2)
            x2 = cx + r2 * math.cos(a1 - math.pi/2)
            y2 = cy + r2 * math.sin(a1 - math.pi/2)
            x3 = cx + r2 * math.cos(a2 - math.pi/2)
            y3 = cy + r2 * math.sin(a2 - math.pi/2)
            x4 = cx + r1 * math.cos(a2 - math.pi/2)
            y4 = cy + r1 * math.sin(a2 - math.pi/2)
            
            large_arc = 1 if (a2 - a1) > math.pi else 0
            
            path_d = f"M{int(x2)},{int(y2)} L{int(x1)},{int(y1)} A {int(r1)} {int(r1)} 0 {large_arc} 1 {int(x4)} {int(y4)} L{int(x3)},{int(y3)} A {int(r2)} {int(r2)} 0 {large_arc} 0 {int(x2)} {int(y2)} "
            svg_lines.append(f"<path fill='{col}' d='{path_d}'/>")
            
        svg_lines.append("</svg>")
        out_content = "\n".join(svg_lines) + "\n"
        if out_file == '-':
            sys.stdout.write(out_content)
        else:
            with open(out_file, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                f.write(out_content)
                
    elif fmt == 'html':
        out_content = f"""<?xml version='1.0' standalone='no'?>
<!DOCTYPE html PUBLIC '-//W3C//DTD SVG 1.1//EN' 
 'http://www.w3.org/Graphics/SVG/1.1/DTD/html11.dtd'>
<html xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/html' xmlns:xlink= 'http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink'>
<canvas id='duc_canvas' width='{img_size}' height='{img_size}'>
Your browser does not support the HTML5 canvas tag.
</canvas>
<script type='text/javascript'>
var canvas = document.getElementById('duc_canvas');
var f = Math.floor;
var pi = Math.PI;
var c = canvas.getContext('2d');
c.textAlign = 'center'
c.textBaseline = 'middle'
c.lineJoin = 'round'
</script>
</html>\n"""
        if out_file == '-':
            sys.stdout.write(out_content)
        else:
            with open(out_file, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                f.write(out_content)
    elif fmt in ('png', 'pdf'):
        try:
            cairo = ctypes.CDLL('libcairo.so.2')
            cairo.cairo_image_surface_create.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
            cairo.cairo_image_surface_create.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int]
            cairo.cairo_pdf_surface_create.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
            cairo.cairo_pdf_surface_create.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
            cairo.cairo_create.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
            cairo.cairo_create.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
            cairo.cairo_surface_write_to_png.restype = ctypes.c_int
            cairo.cairo_surface_write_to_png.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_char_p]
            cairo.cairo_destroy.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
            cairo.cairo_surface_destroy.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
            cairo.cairo_arc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
            cairo.cairo_arc_negative.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
            cairo.cairo_close_path.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
            cairo.cairo_set_source_rgb.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
            cairo.cairo_fill.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
            
            if fmt == 'pdf':
                surf = cairo.cairo_pdf_surface_create(out_file.encode('utf-8'), float(img_size), float(img_size))
            else:
                surf = cairo.cairo_image_surface_create(0, img_size, img_size)
                
            cr = cairo.cairo_create(surf)
            cx = img_size / 2.0
            cy = img_size / 2.0
            r_inner = img_size * 0.1
            r_step = (img_size * 0.4) / max_levels
            
            for w in wedges:
                lvl, a1, a2, name, val, col = w
                if lvl == 0:
                    continue
                r1 = r_inner + (lvl - 1) * r_step
                r2 = r1 + r_step
                
                hc = col.lstrip('#')
                r_val = int(hc[0:2], 16) / 255.0
                g_val = int(hc[2:4], 16) / 255.0
                b_val = int(hc[4:6], 16) / 255.0
                
                cairo.cairo_set_source_rgb(cr, r_val, g_val, b_val)
                cairo.cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, r2, a1 - math.pi/2, a2 - math.pi/2)
                cairo.cairo_arc_negative(cr, cx, cy, r1, a2 - math.pi/2, a1 - math.pi/2)
                cairo.cairo_close_path(cr)
                cairo.cairo_fill(cr)
                
            if fmt == 'png':
                if out_file == '-':
                    cairo.cairo_surface_write_to_png(surf, b'/tmp/duc_tmp.png')
                    with open('/tmp/duc_tmp.png', 'rb') as f:
                        sys.stdout.buffer.write(f.read())
                    try:
                        os.remove('/tmp/duc_tmp.png')
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                else:
                    cairo.cairo_surface_write_to_png(surf, out_file.encode('utf-8'))
                    
            cairo.cairo_destroy(cr)
            cairo.cairo_surface_destroy(surf)
        except Exception as e:
            sys.stderr.write(f"Error drawing graph: {e}\n")
            
    db.close()

def cmd_ui(cmd_args, config):
    flags_def = [
        ("apparent", ["-a"], ["--apparent"]),
        ("bytes", ["-b"], ["--bytes"]),
        ("count", [], ["--count"]),
        ("name_sort", ["-n"], ["--name-sort"]),
        ("no_color", [], ["--no-color"]),
    ]
    opts_def = [("database", ["-d"], ["--database"])]
    flags, opts, positionals = parse_args_custom(cmd_args, flags_def, opts_def)
    
    db_path = get_db_path("ui", opts.get("database"), config)
    db = DB(db_path)
    
    user_p = positionals[0] if positionals else "."
    canon_p = os.path.realpath(user_p)
    node = db.get(canon_p) or db.get(user_p)
    if not node:
        sys.stderr.write(f"Path {canon_p} not found in database\n")
        sys.stderr.write(f"The requested path '{user_p}' was not found in the database,\n")
        sys.stderr.write("Please run 'duc info' for a list of available directories.\n")
        db.close()
        sys.exit(1)
        
    try:
        import curses
        
        def run_curses(stdscr):
            curses.curs_set(0)
            if "no_color" not in flags and curses.has_colors():
                curses.start_color()
                curses.use_default_colors()
                
            curr_p = canon_p
            sel_idx = 0
            bytes_mode = "bytes" in flags
            apparent_mode = "apparent" in flags
            name_sort = "name_sort" in flags
            
            while True:
                curr_node = db.get(curr_p)
                if not curr_node:
                    break
                    
                ch = curr_node.get("children", [])
                if name_sort:
                    ch.sort(key=lambda c: c.get("name", "").lower())
                else:
                    ch.sort(key=lambda c: (-(c.get("size_apparent" if apparent_mode else "size_actual", 0)), c.get("name", "").lower()))
                    
                h, w = stdscr.getmaxyx()
                stdscr.clear()
                
                header_str = f"  {curr_p}"
                stdscr.attron(curses.A_REVERSE)
                stdscr.addstr(0, 0, header_str[:w].ljust(w))
                stdscr.attroff(curses.A_REVERSE)
                
                max_v = max([c.get("size_apparent" if apparent_mode else "size_actual", 0) for c in ch], default=1)
                
                max_rows = h - 2
                for i in range(min(max_rows, len(ch))):
                    item = ch[i]
                    is_sel = (i == sel_idx)
                    v = item.get("size_apparent" if apparent_mode else "size_actual", 0)
                    sz_s = format_size(v, bytes_mode)
                    
                    p_cnt = round(30 * v / max_v) if max_v > 0 else 0
                    g_s = f"[{'+'*p_cnt:<30s}]"
                    item_s = f"  {sz_s:>8s} {item.get('name', ''):<20s} {g_s}"
                    
                    if is_sel:
                        stdscr.attron(curses.A_REVERSE)
                        stdscr.addstr(i + 1, 0, item_s[:w].ljust(w))
                        stdscr.attroff(curses.A_REVERSE)
                    else:
                        stdscr.addstr(i + 1, 0, item_s[:w])
                        
                tot_v = curr_node.get("size_apparent" if apparent_mode else "size_actual", 0)
                tot_s = format_size(tot_v, bytes_mode)
                f_cnt = curr_node.get("count", 1) - 1
                d_cnt = curr_node.get("dir_count", 1) - 1
                mode_lbl = "apparent" if apparent_mode else "actual"
                footer_str = f" Total {tot_s} in {f_cnt} files and {d_cnt} directories ({mode_lbl} size)"
                stdscr.attron(curses.A_REVERSE)
                stdscr.addstr(h - 1, 0, footer_str[:w].ljust(w))
                stdscr.attroff(curses.A_REVERSE)
                
                stdscr.refresh()
                
                ch_key = stdscr.getch()
                if ch_key in (ord('q'), 27):
                    break
                elif ch_key in (curses.KEY_UP, ord('k')):
                    sel_idx = max(0, sel_idx - 1)
                elif ch_key in (curses.KEY_DOWN, ord('j')):
                    sel_idx = min(len(ch) - 1, sel_idx + 1)
                elif ch_key in (curses.KEY_RIGHT, 10, 13, ord('l')):
                    if ch and ch[sel_idx].get("is_dir"):
                        curr_p = os.path.join(curr_p, ch[sel_idx].get("name", ""))
                        sel_idx = 0
                elif ch_key in (curses.KEY_LEFT, curses.KEY_BACKSPACE, 127, ord('h')):
                    parent = os.path.dirname(curr_p)
                    if db.get(parent):
                        curr_p = parent
                        sel_idx = 0
                elif ch_key == ord('a'):
                    apparent_mode = not apparent_mode
                elif ch_key == ord('b'):
                    bytes_mode = not bytes_mode
                elif ch_key == ord('n'):
                    name_sort = not name_sort
                    
        curses.wrapper(run_curses)
    except Exception as e:
        sys.stderr.write(f"UI error: {e}\n")
        sys.exit(1)
        
    db.close()

def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print(MAIN_HELP)
        sys.exit(0)
        
    first_arg = sys.argv[1]
    
    if first_arg == "--version":
        print(VERSION_STR)
        sys.exit(0)
    elif first_arg in ("-h", "--help"):
        print(MAIN_HELP)
        sys.exit(0)
        
    if first_arg == "help":

                print(ALL_HELP)
            elif sub in HELP_MAP:
                print(HELP_MAP[sub])
            else:
                print(MAIN_HELP)
        else:
            print(MAIN_HELP)
        sys.exit(0)
        
    subcmd = first_arg
    if subcmd not in HELP_MAP:
        print(MAIN_HELP)
        sys.exit(0)
        
    cmd_args = sys.argv[2:]
    
    if "-h" in cmd_args or "--help" in cmd_args:
        print(HELP_MAP[subcmd])
        sys.exit(0)
        
    if "--version" in cmd_args:
        print(VERSION_STR)
        sys.exit(0)
        
    config = load_config()
    
    if subcmd == "index":
        cmd_index(cmd_args, config)
    elif subcmd == "info":
        cmd_info(cmd_args, config)
    elif subcmd == "ls":
        cmd_ls(cmd_args, config)
    elif subcmd == "topn":
        cmd_topn(cmd_args, config)
    elif subcmd == "histogram":
        cmd_histogram(cmd_args, config)
    elif subcmd == "xml":
        cmd_xml(cmd_args, config)
    elif subcmd == "json":
        cmd_json(cmd_args, config)
    elif subcmd == "graph":
        cmd_graph(cmd_args, config)
    elif subcmd == "cgi":
        cmd_cgi(cmd_args, config)
    elif subcmd == "gui":
        cmd_gui(cmd_args, config)
    elif subcmd == "ui":
        cmd_ui(cmd_args, config)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def load_config():
    config = collections.defaultdict(dict)
    paths = [
        "/etc/ducrc",
        os.path.expanduser("~/.config/duc/ducrc"),
        os.path.expanduser("~/.ducrc"),
        os.path.abspath("./.ducrc"),
    ]
    for p in paths:
        if os.path.isfile(p):
            curr_sec = "global"
            try:
                with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
                    for line in f:
                        line = line.strip()
                        if not line or line.startswith("#") or line.startswith(";"):
                            continue
                        if line.startswith("[") and line.endswith("]"):
                            curr_sec = line[1:-1].strip().lower()
                        else:
                            parts = line.split(None, 1)
                            k = parts[0].strip().lower()
                            v = parts[1].strip() if len(parts) > 1 else True
                            config[curr_sec][k] = v
            except Exception:
                pass
    return config

def format_size(size, bytes_mode=False):
    if bytes_mode:
        return str(size)
    if size < 1024:
        return f"{int(size)}"
    
    units = ['K', 'M', 'G', 'T', 'P', 'E']
    val = float(size) / 1024.0
    u_idx = 0
    while val >= 1000.0 and u_idx < len(units) - 1:
        val /= 1024.0
        u_idx += 1
    
    return f"{val:.1f}{units[u_idx]}"

def format_count(count, bytes_mode=False):
    if bytes_mode:
        return str(count)
    if count < 1000:
        return str(count)
    units = ['K', 'M', 'G', 'T']
    val = float(count) / 1000.0
    u_idx = 0
    while val >= 1000.0 and u_idx < len(units) - 1:
        val /= 1000.0
        u_idx += 1
    return f"{val:.1f}{units[u_idx]}"

def get_db_path(subcmd, cli_db, config):
    if cli_db:
        return cli_db
    if "DUC_DATABASE" in os.environ and os.environ["DUC_DATABASE"]:
        return os.environ["DUC_DATABASE"]
    if "database" in config.get("global", {}):
        return config["global"]["database"]
    if "database" in config.get(subcmd, {}):
        return config[subcmd]["database"]
    
    home = os.path.expanduser("~")
    d1 = os.path.join(home, ".duc.db")
    if os.path.exists(d1):
        return d1
    d2 = os.path.join(home, ".cache", "duc", "duc.db")
    if os.path.exists(d2):
        return d2
    return d1

class DB:
    def __init__(self, db_path, is_index=False):
        self.db_path = db_path
        if not is_index:
            if not os.path.exists(db_path):
                sys.stderr.write(f"Error opening: {db_path} - Database not found\n")
                if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "info":
                    sys.stderr.write("Database not found\n")
                sys.exit(1)
        else:
            parent = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(db_path))
            if parent and not os.path.exists(parent):
                sys.stderr.write(f"Error opening: {db_path} - Database not found\n")
                sys.stderr.write("Database not found\n")
                sys.exit(1)
        try:
            self.conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
            self.conn.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS blobs(key UNIQUE PRIMARY KEY, value BLOB)")
            self.conn.commit()
        except Exception as e:
            sys.stderr.write(f"Error opening: {db_path} - {e}\n")
            sys.exit(1)

    def get(self, key):
        c = self.conn.cursor()
        c.execute("SELECT value FROM blobs WHERE key = ?", (key,))
        row = c.fetchone()
        if row:
            val = row[0]
            if isinstance(val, bytes):
                try:
                    val = val.decode('utf-8')
                except Exception:
                    pass
            try:
                return json.loads(val)
            except Exception:
                return val
        return None

    def set(self, key, value):
        if not isinstance(value, (str, bytes)):
            value = json.dumps(value)
        c = self.conn.cursor()
        c.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO blobs(key, value) VALUES(?, ?)", (key, value))
        self.conn.commit()

    def close(self):
        self.conn.close()

def parse_args_custom(cmd_args, flags, options):
    parsed_flags = set()
    parsed_options = {}
    positionals = []
    
    i = 0
    while i < len(cmd_args):
        arg = cmd_args[i]
        matched = False
        
        for name, short_aliases, long_aliases in flags:
            if arg in short_aliases or arg in long_aliases:
                parsed_flags.add(name)
                matched = True
                break
        if matched:
            i += 1
            continue
            
        for name, short_aliases, long_aliases in options:
            matched_opt = False
            for sa in short_aliases:
                if arg == sa:
                    if i + 1 < len(cmd_args):
                        parsed_options[name] = cmd_args[i+1]
                        i += 1
                    matched_opt = True
                    break
                elif arg.startswith(sa) and len(sa) > 2 and not sa.startswith('--'):
                    parsed_options[name] = arg[len(sa):]
                    matched_opt = True
                    break
            if matched_opt:
                matched = True
                break
            for la in long_aliases:
                if arg == la:
                    if i + 1 < len(cmd_args):
                        parsed_options[name] = cmd_args[i+1]
                        i += 1
                    matched_opt = True
                    break
                elif arg.startswith(la + '='):
                    parsed_options[name] = arg[len(la)+1:]
                    matched_opt = True
                    break
            if matched_opt:
                matched = True
                break
        if matched:
            i += 1
            continue
            
        positionals.append(arg)
        i += 1
        
    return parsed_flags, parsed_options, positionals

def cmd_index(cmd_args, config):
    flags_def = [
        ("bytes", ["-b"], ["--bytes"]),
        ("progress", ["-p"], ["--progress"]),
        ("one_file_system", ["-x"], ["--one-file-system"]),
        ("check_hard_links", ["-H"], ["--check-hard-links"]),
        ("hide_file_names", [], ["--hide-file-names"]),
        ("verbose", ["-v"], ["--verbose"]),
        ("debug", [], ["--debug"]),
        ("dry_run", [], ["--dry-run"]),
    ]
    opts_def = [
        ("database", ["-d"], ["--database"]),
        ("exclude", ["-e"], ["--exclude"]),
        ("max_depth", ["-m"], ["--max-depth"]),
        ("uid", ["-U"], ["--uid"]),
        ("username", ["-u"], ["--username"]),
        ("topn", ["-T"], ["--topn"]),
        ("topn_min", ["-M"], ["--topn-min"]),
    ]
    flags, opts, positionals = parse_args_custom(cmd_args, flags_def, opts_def)
    
    if not positionals:
        sys.stderr.write("duc: missing path argument\n")
        sys.exit(1)
        
    db_path = get_db_path("index", opts.get("database"), config)
    dry_run = "dry_run" in flags
    verbose = "verbose" in flags or "debug" in flags
    
    db = DB(db_path, is_index=True) if not dry_run else None
    
    if verbose and not dry_run:
        sys.stderr.write(f'Writing to database "{db_path}"\n')
        
    for p in positionals:
        canon_path = os.path.realpath(p)
        start_time = time.time()
        
        hist = [0] * 48
        seen_inodes = set() if "check_hard_links" in flags else None
        
        def scan_dir(curr_path, depth):
            try:
                st = os.lstat(curr_path)
            except Exception:
                return None, 0, 0, 0, 0
                
            dir_st_dev = st.st_dev
            children = []
            tot_act = 0
            tot_app = 0
            tot_files = 0
            tot_dirs = 0
            
            try:
                entries = list(os.scandir(curr_path))
            except Exception:
                entries = []
                
            for entry in entries:
                name = entry.name
                if "exclude" in opts and fnmatch.fnmatch(name, opts["exclude"]):
                    continue
                    
                try:
                    e_st = entry.stat(follow_symlinks=False)
                except Exception:
                    continue
                    
                if "one_file_system" in flags and e_st.st_dev != dir_st_dev:
                    continue
                    
                if seen_inodes is not None and e_st.st_nlink > 1:
                    key = (e_st.st_dev, e_st.st_ino)
                    if key in seen_inodes:
                        continue
                    seen_inodes.add(key)
                    
                is_d = entry.is_dir(follow_symlinks=False)
                act_s = getattr(e_st, 'st_blocks', 0) * 512 if hasattr(e_st, 'st_blocks') else e_st.st_size
                app_s = e_st.st_size
                
                bkt = 0
                if act_s > 0:
                    bkt = min(47, max(0, int(math.log2(act_s))))
                hist[bkt] += 1
                
                if is_d:
                    tot_dirs += 1
                    child_node, sub_act, sub_app, sub_f, sub_d = scan_dir(entry.path, depth + 1)
                    c_act = sub_act
                    c_app = sub_app
                    c_cnt = sub_f + sub_d + 1
                    tot_act += c_act
                    tot_app += c_app
                    tot_files += sub_f
                    tot_dirs += sub_d
                    children.append({
                        "name": name,
                        "is_dir": True,
                        "size_actual": c_act,
                        "size_apparent": c_app,
                        "count": c_cnt
                    })
                else:
                    tot_files += 1
                    tot_act += act_s
                    tot_app += app_s
                    c_name = name if "hide_file_names" not in flags else f"file_{tot_files}"
                    children.append({
                        "name": c_name,
                        "is_dir": False,
                        "size_actual": act_s,
                        "size_apparent": app_s
                    })
                    
            node = {
                "path": curr_path,
                "size_actual": tot_act,
                "size_apparent": tot_app,
                "count": tot_files + tot_dirs + 1,
                "dir_count": tot_dirs + 1,
                "children": children
            }
            if db:
                db.set(curr_path, node)
            return node, tot_act, tot_app, tot_files, tot_dirs
            
        root_node, tot_act, tot_app, tot_files, tot_dirs = scan_dir(canon_path, 0)
        dur = max(0.0, time.time() - start_time)
        
        if db:
            reports = db.get("duc_index_reports") or []
            if not isinstance(reports, list):
                reports = []
            now = datetime.datetime.now()
            rep = {
                "path": canon_path,
                "date": now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
                "time": now.strftime("%H:%M:%S"),
                "files": tot_files,
                "dirs": tot_dirs + 1,
                "size_actual": tot_act,
                "size_apparent": tot_app,
                "histogram": hist
            }
            updated = False
            for idx, r in enumerate(reports):
                if r.get("path") == canon_path:
                    reports[idx] = rep
                    updated = True
                    break
            if not updated:
                reports.append(rep)
            db.set("duc_index_reports", reports)
            
        if verbose:
            app_f = f"{tot_app}B" if tot_app < 1024 else f"{format_size(tot_app)}B"
            act_f = f"{tot_act}B" if tot_act < 1024 else f"{format_size(tot_act)}B"
            sys.stderr.write(f"Indexed {tot_files} files and {tot_dirs + 1} directories, ({app_f} apparent, {act_f} actual) in {dur:.2f} secs.\n")
            
    if db:
        db.close()
